purpose: Teach: 友の会/回分/新譜/吹き替え/データー/ゲージ/コンソール/特番

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: お客様の友の会向けに会員特典を充実させましょう
lines.en: Let's expand the membership benefits for our customer loyalty program.
lines.style: Brisk, forward-moving energy. Crisp attack on each phrase. Calm authority without being commanding. She's proposing, not dictating—a light uplift on 'let's' that invites agreement.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。研修プログラムを五回分に分割します
lines.en: Yes. I'll split the training program into five sessions.
lines.style: Earnest and ready. Warm nod in his voice. Not rushed—he's absorbing the task and confirming it back with quiet competence. A beat of understanding before the specifics.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 提携レーベルの新譜情報を社内で共有しましょう
lines.en: Let's share the new release information from our partner labels across the company.
lines.style: Clear directive, steady pace. No edge—just practical necessity. She's building on the previous point. Open tone, like she's thinking aloud with Kenji rather than at him.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。海外動画の吹き替え版を制作します
lines.en: Yes. I'll create dubbed versions of the overseas videos.
lines.style: Confirms and extends. Warm undertone. He's tracking what she's saying and adding his own layer to the plan. Slight lean of ownership—'I'll do this part'—but collaborative, not separate.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 顧客データー管理の精度を上げましょう
lines.en: Let's improve the accuracy of our customer data management.
lines.style: Measured, thoughtful. She's shifting to precision now. Calm but purposeful. A light emphasis on 'accuracy'—this matters for the integrity of what comes next.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。製造ラインのゲージ表示を改修します
lines.en: Yes. I'll upgrade the display gauges on the production line.
lines.style: Direct acknowledgment. Professional but not stiff. He's keeping pace with her agenda. Slight tempo pick-up—these are concrete tasks, doable, and he's tracking them clearly.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 店舗コンソールの操作研修を実施しましょう
lines.en: Let's conduct training on how to operate the store console.
lines.style: Another proposal, same tone as the first—steady, inclusive. She's moving through the list with rhythm. Light emphasis on 'conduct' suggests she sees this as important groundwork.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社内向け特番ライブ配信を準備します
lines.en: Yes. I'll prepare a special live broadcast for internal staff.
lines.style: Final confirmation. Warmth and wrap-up energy. He's met her through the whole list. A small ease at the end—they've got a plan together now. Slight trailing comfort.
